title.en: Seijo-sama no Gyaku Harem kara Abureta Kishi-sama ni Netsuretsu ni Kyuuaisareteiru Ken

altTitles.ja: 关于我被跳出圣女大人逆后宫的骑士大人热烈求爱这件事 聖女様の逆ハーレムからあぶれた騎士様に熱烈に求愛されている件

altTitles.ja-ro: Seijo-sama no Gyaku Harem kara Abureta Kishi-sama ni Netsuretsu ni Kyuuaisareteiru Ken

altTitles.en: the knight who failed to win the saintess’s love poured all his feelings into me

description.en:
“Even Heroes… Fall in Love.”
Yes, that’s normal.
But… “Being held responsible for taking his virginity? I never saw that coming!”

That day was a disaster for Rachel.
She lost her lover to her younger sister, her family sided with the sister, and even decided she would inherit the family name.

Rachel, who had worked tirelessly for years and given everything to support her poor family, was cast aside without a second thought.

At the peak of her despair, she drowned herself in alcohol at a modest tavern… and there, she met Alfred—
One of the heroes who had saved the world, now drinking in sorrow because he had been “kicked out of the Saintess’s harem” for being too conservative!

They talked, shared their sorrows… and with the help of alcohol, lost control of their emotions.

When Rachel opened her eyes the next morning…
“Let’s go file the marriage paperwork.”
“Huh!?”
